definition: TRA2B (transformer 2 beta homolog) is a gene that encodes a splicing regulator protein; pathogenic variants in TRA2B cause Ramond-Elliott neurodevelopmental syndrome (RAMELN; OMIM #621421).

source.title: 602719 - TRANSFORMER 2 BETA HOMOLOG; TRA2B
source.quote: The TRA2B gene encodes a splicing regulator.
